patch_description: Crossover of the best-performing variant (reuse-discounted refinement loop, total cost 756.69) with the k-candidate path enumeration from the inspiration program. Key improvements: (1) for each destination, enumerate up to k shortest simple paths on the discounted graph and pick the one minimizing *incremental* cost (edges already paid for by other destinations/partitions are heavily discounted, encouraging shared broadcast trunks); (2) all partitions of a destination follow the selected consolidated route to avoid paying for multiple parallel trunks; (3) multiple refinement passes with escalating discounts (0.0, 0.25, 0.5) reuse edges discovered in earlier passes, and the final topology is chosen as the one with the lowest undiscounted total cost, guaranteeing we never regress versus the plain-Dijkstra baseline.
